user.title: ZTE Router Configuration
user.description: Configure your ZTE router for device tracking

data.mesh_topology: Mesh topology (see all mesh node devices)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the router. Please check your settings.
error.invalid_input: Invalid input provided. Please check your entries.
error.invalid_model: Selected router model is not supported.

init.title: ZTE Router Options
init.description: Connection, data sources and how quickly device changes are picked up.

connection.name: Router connection
connection.description: Where and how Home Assistant logs in to the router web UI.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the router.

data_sources.name: Data to collect
data_sources.description: Extra router queries. Each one is an additional request on every poll.

data.mesh_topology: Mesh topology (see all mesh node devices)

data_description.query_wan_status: Adds WAN details (IP, link state, uptime, optical levels on supported models) to the router status sensor.
data_description.query_router_details: Adds router model, firmware, uptime, CPU and memory usage to the router status sensor.
data_description.session_reuse: Keep one router login between polls instead of logging in and out every time. Fewer router log entries; a stale session is re-created automatically.
data_description.mesh_topology: Also list devices connected to mesh agent nodes, not only the controller.

refresh.name: Refresh speed
refresh.description: How fast new devices show up.

data.join_refresh: Refresh when a device joins the network

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks the router for devices. Every preset speeds up when devices change. Each poll logs in to the router, so very short intervals can log you out of its web UI.
data_description.join_refresh: Poll the router right after an unknown or disconnected device announces itself on the LAN (heard through ARP, so static IPs work too). Needs Home Assistant on the same network. Off by default.

export_support_bundle.name: Export Router Support Bundle
export_support_bundle.description: Writes a JSON file into the zte_tracker_support folder describing the structure of your router's responses, for attaching to a "please support my model" issue. No hostname, SSID, serial, MAC or IP address is collected.

host.name: Host
host.description: Only export for this router. Omit to export for all configured routers.

acknowledge_sensitive_data.name: I will read the file before sharing it
acknowledge_sensitive_data.description: Node and field names come from your firmware, so have a look before attaching it. Nothing is exported unless this is true.

reboot.name: Reboot router
reboot.description: Reboot the ZTE router. Optionally specify a hostname to reboot only that router.

refresh.name: Refresh router
refresh.description: Poll the ZTE router now instead of waiting for the next interval. Optionally specify a host to refresh only that router.

remove_tracked_entity.name: Remove tracked device
remove_tracked_entity.description: Remove a tracked device entity by MAC address.

mac.name: MAC Address
mac.description: MAC address of the device to remove (e.g. E4:BC:AA:0D:B8:F6)

remove_unidentified_entities.name: Remove unidentified device_tracker entities
remove_unidentified_entities.description: Remove all device_tracker entities that have no unique_id.
